main_text.l: Dei gratia Principis Transylvaniæ, Partium Regni Hungariæ Domini, Siculorum Comitis &c. Conforti gratiosissimæ, Dominæ mihi Clementissimæ, studiorumque meorum Promotrici benignissimæ, munificentissimæ,

page.notes: The imprint at the foot is faint and partly show-through; its last line ("cIↄ IↄC XVIII" in the original form) is read here as MDCXVIII with doubt. The imprint letters are partly illegible and some words are uncertain. The "ᴀᴅ ɪɔɔɔʟXVIII" line is a poor reading: the year is probably MDCXVIII. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
